title: A smooth morning for your 3-year-old
subtitle: 6 simple steps, same order every day

steps.title: Potty and wash hands
steps.note: A step stool helps them do it alone

steps.title: Get dressed
steps.note: Clothes laid out the night before

steps.title: Breakfast
steps.note: Let them pour or stir one thing

steps.title: Brush teeth and hair
steps.note: Sing one short song while you brush

steps.title: Shoes, coat, go
steps.note: A two-minute warning before you leave
